title: Cytotoxic T-Cell Verdict
description: Structured evidence from the CT verification agent. The agent is an investigator, not a judge — it reports what it found at specific locations. Verdicts are determined mechanically from the evidence, not from the agent's opinion.

claim_type.description: What the investigation found — a structural assertion, not an opinion

file.description: Absolute path to the source file examined

line.description: Line number where the relevant code was found

code_snippet.description: The exact code at that location (copy-pasted, not paraphrased)

observation.description: What this code does or does not do, relative to the finding's claim

evidence.description: Concrete evidence from the source files. Each item must cite a real file, real line, and the real code at that line.
